projects.name: Mimir
projects.description: Hydroponic automation platform developed as the professional practice project for Computer Engineering (Ingeniería Informática).
projects.details: The system is built around a central engine written in Go, a React frontend for operating and visualizing the platform, and ESP32 devices programmed in C++ to drive sensors and run hardware tests in the growing setup.
highlights: Developed within the Computer Engineering professional practice framework
Go engine as the core of the system
React frontend for the platform UI
ESP32 + C++ for sensor control and hardware testing

projects.name: Pelambres 3D
projects.description: Professional 3D printing platform for rapid prototyping, custom parts, and on-demand fabrication — based in Martínez, Buenos Aires.
projects.details: The site is a Next.js app (App Router) deployed on Vercel, with a React UI and Tailwind CSS. It covers the full client journey: portfolio and services, quote requests with 3D file uploads (STL, OBJ, 3MF…), order tracking, a print guide, FAQ, courses, and maker tools like a cost calculator and quote generator.
highlights: Public site + quote flow with multi-file uploads
Client tools: cost calculator and quote generator
Order follow-up, courses, print guide, and FAQ

projects.name: Pelambres 3D
projects.description: Plataforma de impresión 3D profesional para prototipado rápido, piezas a medida y fabricación on-demand — en Martínez, Buenos Aires.
